critical_code_review_comments: index.css still uses legacy alias remapping (--brand-purple, --brand-orange, --brand-gold) — works correctly today but recommend a follow-up sweep to rename className usages to canonical ITHR tokens (bg-brand-navy / bg-brand-teal / bg-brand-bright / bg-brand-sky) so the intent is readable. Not blocking for iter 12.

index.html preloads Google Fonts 'Inter' but font-family stack lists 'Calibre','Manrope','Tahoma'; Manrope is imported via @import in index.css (works). Inter link tag in <head> is unused CSS-wise — consider removing to shave one blocking request.

ITHRBrand.jsx line 93: 'dim.replace("px", "") * 0.42' — dim is a string when size is passed as string, but when size is a number the code does `${size}px` then .replace on it (works). Fine but a defensive Number() would be cleaner.
